name: 見出しだけの速報一覧行
prompt:
Create a standalone Japanese breaking-news headline row at the exact proportions of the source crop (1061 x 311 px). Use a clean white background with a thin light-gray divider near the top. Below it, place one bold dark charcoal headline across exactly two lines, followed by a subdued gray reading-time line with generous vertical spacing. Match the native preview for exact localized wording, Japanese sans-serif type, and compact scale while retaining the source's editorial hierarchy and left alignment.
Headline, exactly:
地域の防災を考える
公開フォーラムを開催

Reading time, exactly:
読了まで4分

Use no summary paragraph, image, icons, buttons, or extra text. Keep the row sparse and balanced with clear whitespace, and do not reproduce the English source headline.
reviewNotes: v001を目視確認して候補登録。日本語プレビューの2行見出し・読了時間・上部区切り線を維持。画像サイズ1061×311は原参照の指定領域に一致。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
